finding: `tasks import --write --reconcile-mirror` can append a planning-mirror-reconcile transition to a done task without converging the planning mirror status, so the same task remains classified as `stale-import` immediately after the official recovery command succeeds.
expectedBehavior: A successful reconcile-mirror command should either update the authoritative planning mirror/frontmatter through the proper closeback surface, or fail closed with a recovery command that explains which repo/path must be mutated. It should not record a fresh reconcile transition while leaving the residue bucket unchanged.
evidenceOrRepro: Current `preparePlanningMirrorReconcile` refuses unreadable or non-done ledgers, requires one matching planning card, and writes `status: done` to a planned mirror before recording the reconcile event. `packages/cli/src/commands/tasks/__tests__/import-orchestrator.spec.ts` passes the stale planned mirror scenario, verifies the mirror becomes done, and verifies the completed target ledger remains done with its close metadata intact.
followUp: Keep the single-card and planned-to-done safety checks; any future cross-repository planning closeback change must retain the regression proving both mirror convergence and unchanged completed-ledger metadata.
